slices.title: Media artifact descriptor and verification-state contract (offline portion of the media layer)
slices.brief: Phase 2/3 critical path, offline portion. Add a pure media-artifact descriptor contract: immutable artifact identity anchored to the SHA-256 content hash, artifact type, MIME type, optional duration/dimensions, producer metadata (agent, run, stage, provider), and a fail-closed verification-state machine (unverified by default; verified only through a real FFprobe-style inspection result supplied by the caller; never fabricated). A worker success that lacks a passing verification result must be representable as unverified, never valid. No media generation, no provider calls, no bundled binaries in this slice.
acceptance: Descriptor validation fails closed with stable codes on missing/invalid hash, type, MIME, or producer fields; hash is the identity anchor and tampering with any payload field is detectable
Verification-state machine: unverified -> verified only via a supplied inspection result with matching content hash; any mismatch or missing inspection keeps unverified
Serialized output uses a strict field allowlist; no secrets, locators, or internal agent names (Rules 15/17)
Deterministic: identical inputs produce byte-identical descriptors; no clocks in the identity
Unit tests cover determinism, tamper detection, verification transitions, and allowlist serialization; docs updated; no new dependencies

slices.title: Director-scoped character continuity contract (pure, fail-closed)

acceptance: Character records validate agent scope, bounded fields, and stable error codes; identical inputs produce byte-identical records with recomputed SHA-256 ids and detectable tampering
Cross-Director access fails closed with a stable isolation code; serialization is a strict allowlist with no secrets, locators, or internal agent names (Rules 15/17)
Unit tests cover scoping, determinism, tamper detection, isolation rejections, and serialization; docs updated; no new dependencies

slices.title: TTS adapter contract and persistent voice-continuity profile (contracts only)

acceptance: Voice profiles validate provider/model/language/configuration fields with stable codes, never carry secret material, and are byte-identical for identical inputs

slices.title: FFmpeg assembly-plan contract with sandboxed argument validation and FFprobe verification binding
slices.brief: Media pipeline, offline portion. Add the deterministic assembly-plan contract: inputs are artifact references (descriptor ids, never raw paths), plus ordered segments, transitions, audio-mix plan, subtitle track, aspect-ratio variant selection, and output target. Argument generation is sandbox-safe by construction: only allowlisted artifact references and numeric/enum parameters are accepted; path traversal, shell metacharacters, absolute or user-supplied paths, and unknown fields fail closed with stable codes. The plan binds its output to the artifact-descriptor verification contract, including the main-video runtime QC gate (1800-3000 seconds) that fails closed on unverifiable or out-of-range duration. No FFmpeg execution, no binaries, no media generation in this slice.
acceptance: Assembly plans accept only allowlisted artifact references and bounded enum/numeric parameters; traversal, injection, and unsafe-argument attempts fail closed with stable codes
Runtime QC gate: a main-video outcome outside 1800-3000 seconds, or lacking a real matching inspection result, cannot be represented as complete (fail-closed, integrates artifactDescriptor)
Deterministic byte-identical plans with recomputed ids and tamper detection; unit tests cover argument safety, determinism, QC gate, and serialization; docs updated; no new dependencies

slices.title: Independent content-Reel planning and brand-integration mode contract

slices.title: Episode completeness gate: required streams and measured audio coverage
slices.brief: End-to-end media reliability (Issue #243). No narration scaling, BGM/SFX, subtitle timing, publishing, or provider calls.
